description: We are a group of Computer Science students who believe in software capable of solving real-world problems. Education, the way we see it, is the key to a just society, so throughout our lives we have fought to enhance it. For this challenge, we managed to connect it with agriculture and data analysis. After all, we live in an interconnected world where contributing to the solution of a problem can, with enough creativity, help to answer another. That’s what we stand for.
